_comment: BLAZE POWDER. Swarf is the chip waste off a lathe or mill, and magnesium and titanium swarf
is a real and well-known fire hazard - fine enough to ignite in air, and water makes it
worse rather than better. Reduced to a powder that is what it is: a dust whose whole
Pulverizing, because this changes only fineness. The swarf is not being divided into two
things here - that is the separator's recipe on the same input - it is being made finer
until it behaves the way fine metal does.
Ratio and cost are first-pass; #36 owns them.
COUNT IS 1, and must be (owner, 2026-08-19): a GUI-less machine cannot take N > 1 inputs to
make an output. This was 3. A machine with no GUI and no Container has nothing to open and
nothing to take back out, so a remainder the recipe cannot use is invisible and unrecoverable -
and a remainder is the NORMAL state, because the pull streams hand their scrap out one item at
Ticks and energy are unchanged on purpose. An operation already made one output, so the cost
per output in time and power is the same as before; the only thing that moves is the material
ratio, and that is #36's, whose dial is the drop weight.
